page.layout: One page: a modern digitiser's cover sheet, dark blue with the book title in large white capitals, a rule, and the author's name below. A "Digitized by Google" logo sits at the lower right.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. The large white title and author name are modern cover type, and the Google logo is a digitiser's mark, so none of it is transcribed. No printed page number, running head, catchword or signature appears.
